name: Nevada

law.summary: Since 2025 (SB 276) cities, counties and wastewater districts that know of a sewage discharge to state waters must tell NDEP online or by phone, and NDEP must tell any affected tribe; no deadline and no public notice. Spill rules require phone notice 'as soon as practicable' for releases to surface water.

citations.cite: SB 276 (2025) sec. 3(1)(a), new section of NRS chapter 445A
citations.title: Notification of discharge of sewage
citations.quote: In the event of an incident resulting in the discharge of sewage or industrial waste or any other unauthorized discharge into the waters of the State: (a) Any city, county, unincorporated town, general improvement district, wastewater district or water authority of this State that has powers, duties or jurisdiction within the area of the incident that has been notified or is aware of the incident shall notify the Division electronically on the Internet website of the Division or by telephone.
citations.who: city, county, town, GID, wastewater district or water authority
citations.channel: NDEP (online or phone); NDEP then notifies affected tribes
citations.threshold: any discharge of sewage into waters of the State

citations.title: Notification required as soon as practicable
citations.quote: shall notify the Director as soon as practicable after he or she notifies any emergency response agencies, if required, and initiates any action required to prevent or abate any imminent danger ... if the release: ... (b) Involves any amount of a hazardous substance that is released to surface water
citations.threshold: any amount of a hazardous substance to surface water

regulator_report.deadline: as soon as practicable (spill hotline); permits: 24 hours and five days (NDEP guidance WTS-24, search only)

bills_and_cases: SB 276 (2025) enacted after the unreported 2022 Sparks spill to the Truckee River (signed 2025-05-31 per a tracker).
Pyramid Lake Paiute Tribe suit over the Sparks spill (2025-2026, search only); NDEP settlement with the developer (USD 33,000) and a notice of violation to Sparks (news).

erule.notes: No Nevada collection systems registered in EPA's collection_system_permits.csv; NDEP's eRule route not found.

statewide_feed.notes: NDEP spill database is internal; the portal is intake only.

beaches.program: No state beach program found; Lake Tahoe and Lake Mead beaches not reached

habs.program: Nevada HAB Task Force (NDEP lead) with a Power BI dashboard and a weekly email list

shared_waters: Lake Tahoe and the Truckee River (CA)
Lake Mead, Lake Mohave and the Colorado River (AZ)

barriers.what: Sewage spill notices to NDEP are not published
SB 276 gave tribes notice but the public none
HAB status is a Power BI dashboard plus a weekly email
barriers.note: Owner can subscribe to 'Nevada Harmful Algal Bloom Updates'.

subscriptions.name: Nevada Harmful Algal Bloom Updates (NDEP list)
subscriptions.what: weekly HAB data and health advisories by email

readiness.rationale: No CSOs, no SOBE events, no public spill list. Show plant outfalls, the rain caution, HAB status from the email list, and the plain statement.

owner_questions: Subscribe to the Nevada HAB weekly email (the only HAB channel besides Power BI)?
Records request to NDEP for SB 276 sewage notices since mid-2025, which exist but are unpublished?
surprise: Nevada's 2025 law after the unreported Sparks spill into the Truckee River now makes towns tell the state, and the state tell the downstream tribe, but nobody has to tell the public, and there is no deadline.
